liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin’** (2 reviews): The segue into Big Boss Man, a Pigpen tune, was a highlight; Setlist error: Set 1 track 1 should be listed as Truckin' flowing into Big Boss Man [6][10]
- **Bertha** (2 reviews): Played with the energy of earlier years, and the band kept momentum up until Drums/Space; Listener synced the Bertha audio with audience-shot video, posted on YouTube [6][11]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Listener found Eyes of the World beyond words [14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The whole arena danced and grooved through Scarlet into Fire on the Mountain [6]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Midway through, Jeff plays with a riff from The Who's song Drowned [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big Boss Man**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 10 archived performances [15]
- **In The Midnight Hour**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 10 archived performances [15]
- Earliest performances in the archive: West L.A. Fadeaway, Loser, The Wheel, Looks Like Rain [15]

## The recordings

- **dea2015-11-06** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 171 min; rated 4.56/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Overall sound is great; slight clipping in Drums/Space made the listener's subwoofer boom [12]
- **DeadCo2015.11.06.audmtx**: source not stated; 0 songs; 172 min [2]

## Around the show

- Listener was behind the stage near the rear speaker stacks, with almost nobody close to that area most of the show [3]
- Bobby's voice and playing seemed livelier than in recent times, with Oteil and Jeff fitting in perfectly [9]
- Listener brought their teenagers to the show; John Mayer's playing stood out [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dea2015-11-06**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: DPA 4023 (NOS) > Sound Devices 744 (24/48) [1]
- **DeadCo2015.11.06.audmtx**: Source 1 by Alex Leary: DPA 4023 microphones, NOS pattern, into a Sound Devices 744 at 24-bit/48k; Source 2 by Nate Evans (tapernate): Neumann USM69 and AK50 mics into an SD788 recorder at 24-bit/96k [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.bibliopolis.com: [Dead and Company - 2015 - Fall Tour - Poster - Washington, DC. Verizon Center, Nov 6, 2015 on Mullen Books](https://www.mullenbooks.com/pages/books/195319/dead-and-company-2015-fall-tour-poster-washington-dc-verizon-center-nov-6-2015) [16]
- Poster by www.bibliopolis.com: [Dead and Company - 2015 - Fall Tour - Poster - Washington, DC. Verizon Center, Nov 6, 2015 on Mullen Books](https://www.mullenbooks.com/pages/books/195319/dead-and-company-2015-fall-tour-poster-washington-dc-verizon-center-nov-6-2015) [17]
